reviews.zh: 真係好好⋯雖然暫時未知佢嘅長期效果，但到目前為止我真係好滿意。佢令到我眼周肌膚好滑好滑、好有光澤、又夠保濕。我好鍾意佢吸收得好快。所以對佢好滿意。

reviews.text: I love the tip of the application it makes it easy to apply around the eye area. It hasn't cause any irritation nor it has any smell. It is creamy a sn it hidrated my eye area. I use this one during the day.

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Probio-Cica Bakuchiol Eye Cream 20ml
reviews.text:
I’ve waited about a month to do this review to give this product a fair shot. 

The applicator design is useful so I do enjoy that. You should be careful applying the product under your eyes using it, I have gotten it in my eye doing so. Great news it doesn’t sting very long so that’s great as well. I recommend just using your finger to apply it if anything.

Truthfully I haven’t seen a difference in my dark circles so if that’s the reason you’re reaching for this product I’d recommend something else. It was one of the listed uses so I gave it a shot but it seems to lack on that front. Maybe after continuing to use it past this month I’ll see results. If anything changes and I can update my review I will.

It definitely does help reduce fine lines which is great because with my eye shape I’m prone to lines earlier in life. If you struggle with fine wrinkles then I definitely recommend this product!
reviews.zh:
我等咗差唔多一個月先寫呢個評價，係想畀個公平嘅機會呢件產品。

塗抹頭嘅設計幾有用，所以呢點我幾鍾意。用佢塗抹嘅時候要小心啲，唔好掂到眼，我試過唔小心入到眼。慶幸係嗰吓刺激感唔會維持好耐，所以都算係好事。如果有咩唔妥，我建議直接用手指塗就得。

講真，我眼嘅黑眼圈並冇明顯改善，所以如果你買佢係為咗對付黑眼圈，我會建議揀第二樣。佢其中一個賣點就係咁，所以我先試咗，但呢方面似乎差咁啲。可能繼續用超過一個月會見到效果都未定。如果有變化我可以更新嘅話我會更新。

佢真係有助減淡細紋，因為我眼形嘅關係，我好早就開始有細紋，所以呢點真係好。如果你係受細紋皺紋困擾，我一定推薦呢件產品！

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Probio-Cica Bakuchiol Eye Cream 20ml
reviews.text:
SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Probio-Cica Bakuchiol Eye Cream: I love the packaging as I can easily spread the product while giving it some soothing effect on the under-eye

Medicube Zero Pore Pad: Has a strong smell, sometimes give off a prick sensation on my face but my skin did not purge out while using this product

Numbuzin No. 3 Tingle Pore Softening Sheet Mask: Heard positive great review about it can’t wait to try!

CLIO Kill Brow Auto Hard Brow Pencil: My all time fave product of Clio! As it gives off a natural look and it stays long, and the product is easy to glide
reviews.zh:
SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Probio-Cica Bakuchiol Eye Cream：我好鍾意佢嘅包裝，可以輕易推開產品之餘，又可以畀到眼底少少舒緩感。

Medicube Zero Pore Pad：味道好重，有時用上面會有吉吉哋嘅感覺，但用緊期間皮膚冇爆瘡。

Numbuzin No. 3 Tingle Pore Softening Sheet Mask：聽過好多好評，好期待試！

CLIO Kill Brow Auto Hard Brow Pencil：係 Clio 一直以來我最鍾意嘅產品！望落自然、持久、上色又順。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Probio-Cica Bakuchiol Eye Cream 20ml
reviews.text:
I have beenn using this for quite some time and I'm very happy with the results. I noticed a significant improvement of the fine lines and wrinkles under my eyes.
I have very sensitive skin, especially around this area, and retinol is quite difficult for me to use without causing irritation. 
The texture is rich and buttery, it absorbs well and is very hydrating. 
I love all Skin 1004 products, they're absolutely amazing 👏
reviews.zh: 我用咗呢款一段時間，對效果非常滿意。我留意到眼底嘅細紋同皺紋有明顯改善。我皮膚好敏感，尤其係眼周位置，用視黃醇好容易刺激到。呢款質地豐盈又絲滑，吸收得好，而且非常保濕。Skin 1004 嘅產品我全部都鍾意，佢哋真係超勁 👏

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Probio-Cica Bakuchiol Eye Cream 20ml
reviews.text:
Love that this eye cream comes in an applicator head style. I was drawn to this product because my love for skin1004 but also because the bakuchiol active peeked my interest. I have noticed an improvement in the fine lines around my eyes. 

The only thing that I don’t particularly love is the thickness of this cream… the applicator does well but I find I have to go in and really pat the product in.
reviews.zh: 好鍾意呢款眼霜係用塗抹頭設計。我會留意呢件產品除咗因為我鍾意 skin1004，亦因為 bakuchiol 呢個活性成分引起我興趣。我留意到眼周細紋有改善。唯一我唔係特別鍾意嘅係呢款霜嘅質地偏厚⋯塗抹頭表現唔錯，但我要再返去慢慢拍至吸收。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
